conclusion: The endpoint has C_delete>0 and xi<0, but the apparent straight path from the positive orthant exits C_delete>0 through an interval only about 1.4e-5 wide. It is not a domination counterexample.
refutes: treating C_delete>0 at both endpoints as proof that they lie in the same positivity component
leaves_open: a different exact path placing the endpoint in the distinguished component
